defaultSandboxLaunchFailure.error: browserType.launch: Target page, context or browser has been closed; FATAL content/browser/sandbox_host_linux.cc:41 Check failed: . shutdown: Operation not permitted (1)
defaultSandboxLaunchFailure.followup: Repeat the same reviewed script through the already authorized sandbox escalation for isolated loopback browser QA. This is not a product failure or discarded functional sample.

limitations: Exactly one explicit hover/obstruction/recovery case per version at 1440×900 with low effects; no general occurrence rate, mobile or performance conclusion.
Early Escape without first observing the tooltip is not established by this result; the root QA retained an unsuccessful early-Escape attempt.
No product fix was made. The recovery uses the existing visible Escape instruction and native hidden-state wait.
The initial default-sandbox failure occurred at browser launch before any case; the same reviewed script then ran through the already authorized escalation.
